title: Edmund and the Ledger
author: Silas Almeida
blurb: Petra Vane, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
